bybit.origin: Bybit testnet 2026-10-04; decision receipt→first live observation, cancel_send→terminal observation
bybit.measurement_note: Few observations; descriptive quantile, not a stable mainnet p95. Receipt→live includes private/REST observation delay.

grvt.origin: GRVT testnet interrupted execution check; decision receipt→first live observation
grvt.measurement_note: 3 live observations; includes private/REST observation delay. Valid cancel timing unavailable; entry budget used as cancel proxy.

arcus.origin: Conservative cross-venue proxy: maximum recorded Bybit/GRVT descriptive 95th percentile
arcus.measurement_note: Not measured on this venue. Primary assumption, with separate 2x stress scenario.

bitget.origin: Conservative cross-venue proxy: maximum recorded Bybit/GRVT descriptive 95th percentile
bitget.measurement_note: Not measured on this venue. Primary assumption, with separate 2x stress scenario.
